display.title: Water, Hashem's Precious Gift: Why We Wash Negel Vasser
display.summary_short: Why water is one of Hashem's greatest gifts, and how its special power of purity is why we wash negel vasser every morning.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi explains that most of the world is covered with water and that life would be impossible without it: water makes things grow and keeps us healthy. Hashem placed the sun over 93 million miles away, exactly far enough that the oceans neither boil away nor freeze into ice, a great miracle and kindness. We pray for rain and say the brachah Shehakol before drinking. Hashem also gave water a special spiritual power of taharah, to make us pure, a secret known only to Him. The Torah tells how the Kohanim washed their hands and feet from the copper basin at the entrance of the Mishkan, and that is why we begin each day by washing negel vasser, so that we can serve Hashem in cleanliness and purity.
display.lesson: Appreciate Hashem's gift of water, and start every day by washing negel vasser so you serve Hashem in purity.
